statement: A hold is addressed by the slot it sits in, never by position: resolving or expiring one hold leaves every other hold in its slot and in its order.
source: Review B of PR 73 (coordinator decision 09-30); Quint HtlcResolve{id}, the contract's slot ids

layers.arrival: owed: spec thread (an Arrival page for addressing a hold by slot)

killers.name: R-HOLD-SLOT a hold keeps its slot while others come and go
R-HOLD-SLOT expiring a hold removes the one it names and keeps the others in order
